description: This file defines the class TooManyEvaluationsException, which is a specific exception indicating that the maximum number of evaluations has been exceeded within the Apache Commons Math3 library. It extends MaxCountExceededException and is part of the exception package.

classes.name: TooManyEvaluationsException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the maximum number of evaluations has been exceeded.

methods.name: TooManyEvaluationsException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the maximum number of evaluations allowed.
